rows.message: DELETE /products/:param has no guard in front of it and reaches products, while the 2 other writes of ProductsController have StaffGuard in front.
rows.evidence: every other write of its router is guarded and the routes of src/products/products.controller.ts were read whole; no public marker is on it

call-to-missing-route.why: some routes of legacy-api were not read (route-path-dynamic)

type-never-published.why: 1 publish(es) on stock_events send a type not read

config-not-set.why: no deployment file of storefront was read: its settings may be set where the reading does not look
